02 / A FRIENDLY DISTRACTION

Your move,
human.

I built two Connect X bots with very different ambitions. One wants to win. The other really, really wants you to.

Drop a piece into any column. Connect 4 in a row, column, or diagonal to win.

PICK YOUR OPPONENT

A bot that deliberately helps its opponent win. Yes, really.

A peek inside the bots ↗

Your opponents run the original Python files, right here in your browser. Best Bot uses a strategy book when playing first on the standard board, with a timed search for other positions. “Best” is a name, not an unbeatable claim.

submission.py ↓opponent_win.py ↓

Best Bot includes WeakC4 by 2swap & contributors, under GPL-3.0.

03 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE DESK

Hi again.
I’m Siddharth.

I like the space where code meets curiosity. Sometimes that looks like teaching a bot to navigate Minecraft. Sometimes it’s making a game with a team, building learning tools, or writing an agent whose entire job is to lose.

This workshop is a home for those projects — the useful ones, the playful ones, and the ones that start with a question.
